description: A ticket with its messages oldest first (author_role user = the customer, admin = the Halfpenny Mac team), so you can see what the team has said. Attachments are listed by name and size only; the files are on the dashboard thread at the ticket url. Reading marks the ticket as seen. Needs the support scope.
